title: Swap For Longest Repeated Character Substring
summary: Given a string, you may swap two characters to find the longest substring with repeating characters.
statement: Given a string, you may swap two characters to find the longest substring with repeating characters. Return the length of this substring.
constraints: At most one swap may be performed.
Return the longest all-equal substring length.
hints: Count total occurrences of each candidate character.
For one character, slide a window containing at most one different character.
Its achievable run is min(window length,total copies); maximize across windows and characters.
The one mismatch can be swapped with an outside copy, while the total count caps the result.
editorial: The one mismatch can be swapped with an outside copy, while the total count caps the result.

tests.explanation: Swapping one b with an a creates a run of three a characters.
The separated a groups can form a run of six because only six a characters exist.
